notes:
Summary: enterprise ecommerce search provider. Primary pain = cost and latency at massive scale (index target 200M->1B vectors). Wants a federated retrieval stack: fast ANN for recall + GPU-based cross-encoder reranker for result quality.

Key ask (from CTO): 'We need unit economics — not just accuracy. Show us cost/query at 200M vectors with 99th pct latency under 200ms for single-region queries.'

Technical constraints: heavy image+text multimodal embeddings (64kB per item compressed), frequent index refresh (daily partial reindexes), strict PII retention rules for EU customers (data residency + redact PII before embedding).

Preferred approach discussed: Redwood Dedicated for ANN serving + Redwood Optimize to tune batching/caching; fallback to Private on-prem for regulated EU clients. Interested in automatic prefix caching and shard-aware routing.

Models: open-embedding models preferred (small, quantized; 1536-d or 1024-d), but will run comparative eval vs commercial embeddings (cost/quality tradeoffs). Reranking to run as cross-encoder on GPU for top-100 hits. Considering late interaction / hybrid (lexical+semantic) to reduce false positives.

Operational concerns: warm-start latency for cold queries, KV cache invalidation after partial reindex, index compaction strategy for high-churn SKUs. Wants telemetry per-route: token cost, unit cost/query, per-model latency p50/p95/p99.

Previous conversations: AE demo (01/21) showed baseline qps, SE deep-dive (01/28) on shard topology and HNSW tuning. Security review kickoff (02/03) — customer provided SOC2 checklist.

Quote from SE: 'If we can show 200M vector regressed cost below $0.0008 per query with p99 < 200ms using Dedicated + Optimize policies, they move to pilot.'

Stubs/links: pricing deck in Drive, security questions spreadsheet, internal JIRA INF-7342 tracking VPN firewall rule changes.

Short-term POC scope (agreed):
- Ingest 250M sample vectors (mix of image+text)
- Run recall baseline with HNSW/IVF+PQ variants
- Implement GPU cross-encoder rerank for top-100
- Measure latency/cost across 3 traffic profiles (burst, steady, seasonal)
- Deliver telemetry dashboard with per-route cost KPIs

Notes style: fragments, bullets, shorthand. Follow-ups: legal NDA, SOC2 artifacts upload, POC timeline confirmation (3 weeks), proposal update with dedicated commit options.
